notes:
- New style: Film's own. Inkreel measures the film's colours from its frames and prints the comic in them, as a flat screen-print palette. Drawn and animated films keep their own colours with firmer outlines, and Inkreel suggests this look when a film looks drawn.
- New look from pictures: go past the last STYLE to open it, then add 3 to 20 posters, stills or comic pages. Inkreel reads their colours, outlines, shading and paper grain, shows two frames of your movie in the look, and saves it to your Comics folder's Looks folder so it appears in STYLE.
- Changing a look never watches the film again.
